key_insight: A thin high work-function metal interlayer between ITO and NiOx can significantly reduce the hole-injection barrier and boost perovskite LED brightness.
engineering_relevance: This is a simple, scalable contact-engineering strategy that could improve PeLED efficiency without changing the active emissive stack.
method: Simulated an all-inorganic PeLED using drift-diffusion and Poisson equations in Setfos.
Inserted a 2 nm high work-function metal layer between the ITO anode and NiOx hole transport layer.
Compared Au with other high work-function metals such as Pd and Pt.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that a 2 nm Au interlayer increased luminance by more than 18× in simulation.
watch_item: The result is simulation-based, so real-device performance may differ due to interfacial quality, thickness control, and process compatibility.
paper_title: Boosting Perovskite Light-Emitting Diodes Performance by Introducing High Work-function Metal Transition Layer
